name: equity-condor-robust-backtest-v2
notes: ADR-0256 (PROPOSED, owner-approved contract): the ADR-0255 robust condor replay on an EXECUTABLE DECISION CLOCK. Decide after the close of t from information known at t; one order for the first session t' > t; all four legs fill at the t' VWAP with the ARM's own haircut and liquidity rule, all-or-none. A leg without a t' bar, failing the arm rule at t', or with a negative net short price leaves the order 'unfilled': counted by reason, never replaced. Expiry stays the forecast's own, so the hold shortens (remaining_dte recorded) and fills are dated t'. Everything else is the run-equity-condor-robust-backtest.json document; the changes are: a 'fills' stream and fill_session 'next' on the chain, null max_relative_gap, block_geometry 'edge_padded', exercise_threshold_usd 0.01 on settlement, and the labels. The fill PRICE is still a daily-bar VWAP proxy (owned option data have no bid/ask/size): a bar-proxy replay on an executable decision clock, never production-realistic or a qualification. 2024-2025 is already inspected: development evidence only. Run 793013c0 is never re-run or edited. The replay itself needs separate authorization. v2 (ADR-0256): same-day average fill accepted by the owner; edge-padded rho support; null relative gap with primal parity; exercise disclosure flags. Account study runs read-only afterwards.

option_rows.notes: Verified bounded exact-DTE31 derived chain; source corpus404 symbols, retained modeled chain388 of intended392. Outside-model rows preserved in private refusal ledger. Never read mixed-year original streams here.

option_chain.notes: Implemented pure exact-DTE adapter; source conversion must normalize verified integral contract multiplier/volume/count values. This node does not provide a protected reader or certify price basis. ADR-0256: fill_session 'next' attaches each row's t' bar as 'fill' (or null) from the fills port; 'same' (the default) is the ADR-0255 identity. Owner decision 2026-10-09: the same-day average (VWAP) fill is the accepted assumption, the best the owned data allow (the archive holds only DTE 31-45 per session, so no next-session bar exists: adr0256-fills-census-v1.json); fill_session 'same'.

as_traded.notes: Historical USD/share close reconstructed from same-vintage split-adjusted close and explicit action inventories, conditional on their completeness. All returned market rows pre2026. Unknown or unreconciled histories remain per-context refusals; no fabricated prices.

holding_exclusions.notes: Explicit basis/action/phase refusals, with holding-window check through max(nominal expiry, saved settlement). Full original forecast coverage retained.

forecasts.notes: All99225 exact saved seed11 curves retained, using nine chronological checkpoints; model reference/curve/fit/checkpoint/input identities unchanged. As-traded spot and new source identity bind price-basis reconstruction; original source identity and raw forecast hash retained. No inference, fits or later-checkpoint substitution.

masses.notes: Implemented projection. Numerical integration tolerances are explicit proposed research settings, not empirical calibration. CDF/W1 values are retained as diagnostics only; null disables only their admission cutoffs. Grid is all pre-liquidity strikes; clipped tails and placement diagnostics do not supply continuous-distribution coverage or added rho.

rho_calibration.notes: Reviewed child audit adapter over shared generic bootstrap/grid owners; pricing tiers are frozen by the approved calibration-window median rule. Expected-loss candidate uses realized MINUS robust loss; upper mean bound <=0. Template evidence covers only that fixed population, not all MILP-selected trades. Match SP to F^-1(short_q) and SC to F^-1(1-short_q), each at the nearest same-type strike (distance tie lower), longs wing_strikes distinct same-type positions outward; require this node's explicit liquidity params, pinned equal to select base liquidity, standard contract and strict ordering, otherwise missing-template refusal. Payoff-only audit never uses completed-window pricing tiers. Calendar blocks: starts are observed dates; complete [start,start+B) date groups require start+B <= last_observed+1 day; uniform eligible-start sampling with replacement, concatenate until n dates and truncate; no calendar wrap. Before bounding, require every target date to have positive inclusion probability under this exact sampler and at least two distinct supported blocks; otherwise emit unsupported, never a passing bound. A passing bound also requires the full observed-date residual mean <=0. Refuse insufficient min_dates/no complete blocks/degenerate support, retain inclusion counts and full mean. This is an approximate block stress diagnostic, not a finite-sample confidence guarantee. Primary selection only; longer sensitivity reported. Legacy observed-count behavior stays unchanged. Owner approved expected-loss criterion and the finite-grid/smallest-passing procedure; Owner approved direct strike-grid calibration without adding a projection offset; score weights follow the reviewed formulation. Projection diagnostics are reported separately, not added to rho. No passing grid value means unsupported, without automatic expansion. Compute fixed-template/radius loss values once per exact forecast/checkpoint/input/grid/payoff/band/numerical identity; rho0 may use nominal expected loss directly. Bootstrap reuses cached residuals, never repeats LP solves. Verified derived input source is bound above. Owner approved monthly updates using calibration and entry-phase fixed audit-template outcomes, whether or not the optimizer traded. Admit only outcomes settled and published strictly before the configured monthly reference. The rule and template stay frozen; actual selected-trade outcomes do not replace the audit population. Recompute the bound from eligible past residuals, reusing matching loss values; never revise earlier decisions. Every used outcome is published strictly before monthly reference. Emit rho and JSON audit dict (bounds/residuals/blocks/counts/all refusals), consumed by diagnostics. No test-profit selection. Base-template liquidity is unchanged across all sensitivity arms; they reuse the same rho, never recalibrate. ADR-0256 (5): block_geometry 'edge_padded' (EdgePaddedCalendarBlockBootstrap) lets trailing dates be covered: all 20 zero-inclusion sets in 793013c0 were trailing, so refusal was a property of the date set. Inclusion is positive but NOT equal weight. Absent = the legacy circular sampler.

select.notes: Candidate batch adapter runs the eight explicitly declared one-factor arms once; no foreach duplicates them. Tiers use actual calibration-window ticker medians with symbol-rank ties. Decision marks are the own-date VWAP; fills are the next session's VWAP (ADR-0256). Legacy wording: own-date VWAP, fee0.65 and haircut assumptions remain research conventions. Calibrated arms refuse null rho; nominal is explicitly a research comparator. All ordered eligible strikes; no cap. Preserves solver certificates, model provenance, holding exclusions and skips. ADR-0256: when chain rows carry 'fill', each trade is repriced leg by leg at the t' VWAP with THIS arm's haircut multiplier, liquidity thresholds and ticker tier, all-or-none (status 'unfilled' with unfilled_reason, counted in evidence.fill, never replaced); a filled selection records fill_date, decision and fill credit, slippage_usd and remaining_dte. max_relative_gap null (ADR-0256 (6)) makes the relative gap diagnostic only; the absolute gap 1e-6 and the tie rules still decide. ADR-0256 (6): objective_parity_usd 1e-5 is frozen by the pre-declared rule max(max_absolute_gap_usd, 10 x the largest discrepancy) over the no-outcome parity dry run adr0256-parity-dryrun-v1.json (300 solves, 60 seeded contexts x 5 radii; largest 1.0000106e-6, on the tie structure, which equals the tie slack); it must exceed tie_tolerance_usd. max_relative_gap null = diagnostic only. Never revised after results.

labels.fill: assumed same-day average fill (owner-accepted assumption; no next-session bar in the owned archive)
labels.exercise: intrinsic settlement at the as-traded expiry close; early exercise, assignment and share delivery not simulated

settle.notes: Implemented child adapter reuses public dskit.production.accounting.WindowBook as sole accounting fold. Preserve raw entry and opposite-side synthetic expiry orders/fills for EACH leg, including zero intrinsic and zero expiry fee; these are evidence records, NOT dskit-eval-v1 events. Fold share-equivalent quantity=contracts*multiplier, USD/share prices and total USD fee (entry fee once per contract, zero expiry fee); never multiply fee again. Instrument is decision-scoped position_id encoding arm/decision/actual contract; retain actual contract and one-lot mapping. Both fills carry fill_label, expiry also labels.exercise. Reuse shared bounded settlement-close rule; later confirming bar itself pre2026. Assert per-position signed quantities end zero and WindowBook.realised equals independent closed-form multiplier*(credit-intrinsic)-entry fees. Do not use leg closes as trade counts. One condor outcome per decision. Evidence retains all raw records, mappings, reconciliation, arm/ticker outcomes/skips; no portfolio return or generic leg-statistic claims. ADR-0256: entry fills are dated the selection's fill_date; unfilled selections are skipped and counted; with exercise_threshold_usd 0.01 each outcome discloses per-leg itm / pin_zone flags and would_deliver_shares. Disclosure only: P&L stays intrinsic.

params.title: Robust condor calibration and single-trade evidence

diagnostics.notes: EXISTS RunReport with stages enabled. Stage labels identify mesh, calibration, selection and settlement. Exhaustive JSON preserves every raw decision/order/fill/solver/outcome/refusal record, diagnostic and reconciliation; Markdown renders stage summaries with its documented row cap and full-JSON pointer. Existing node-scoped artifact writer isolates arms. Condor outcomes are the statistical unit, not leg trips; no portfolio return. Shared base calibration is unchanged across comparison arms.
